summary: BJ's Wholesale Club Holdings filed an 8-K on September 8, 2026, disclosing that on September 4, 2026 it reached a settlement agreement resolving credit card interchange fee litigation in which the Company was a plaintiff. The settlement yields a one-time pre-tax benefit of approximately $240 million, net of associated legal fees, expected to be recorded in third quarter fiscal 2026 results. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, stake, premium, close date, break fee, or structural deal mechanics were disclosed. This is a litigation settlement, not a special situation. Watch for Q3 fiscal 2026 earnings confirmation of the benefit and any impact on guidance, cash flow, or capital allocation.
